centre.description: An ice giant that spins on its side, with thin dark rings.
knownLimitations: Uranus's picture is a Solar System Scope map (CC BY 4.0) based on NASA imagery; the planet is nearly featureless in visible light.
The surface drawn is the 1-bar cloud-top level, not a solid surface.

The rings are drawn as flat bands in Planetary Explorer's colours; the nine narrow inner rings are grouped as the donor draws them, and a ring narrower than the picture can show is drawn wider than it is. Brightness is a look, not a measurement.
None of Uranus's moons has a map picture here: all 28 are shown as dots in family colours.
